items.title: A module flat over A is flat over B when B tensor over A B maps flatly onto B
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)

items.difficulty_reason: The statement is a criterion used throughout the weakly etale theory: for a ring map A -> B such that B tensor_A B -> B is flat, every B-module N that is flat as an A-module is flat as a B-module (statement lines 30201-30206). The proof is short but it is a complete argument rather than a citation: flatness of N over A makes the functor N tensor_A from B-modules to B tensor_A B-modules exact, the flatness hypothesis keeps exactness after extending scalars back to B, and the composite is then identified with N tensor_B (proof lines 30209-30220). The content is the correct choice of the intermediate category and the identification of the composite functor, which is what makes the statement true without any finiteness hypothesis. The counted span is self-contained: it refers to no labelled item of the chapter and cites nothing.
